title: Ask-entry/bid-exit replay approximates executable fills
current_evidence: Replay uses ask-entry and bid-exit; latest inspected paper sessions did not prove submitted fills.
falsification_test: Collect paper/no-order evidence by side premium spread quote age latency time bucket and compare against replay assumptions.
confidence_increases_if: Fill distribution remains profitable after realistic age latency spread and non-fill modeling.
confidence_destroyed_if: Observed fills materially worse than replay or concentrated in unfilled stale/wide quotes.

title: Live quote age semantics match historical quote age semantics
current_evidence: Historical and live quote-age paths are not proven identical.
falsification_test: Audit raw quote timestamp received timestamp decision timestamp guard timestamp and replay timestamp alignment.
confidence_increases_if: Matched rows show identical quote-age semantics within explicit tolerance.
confidence_destroyed_if: Live guard accepts quotes that historical reconstruction would mark stale or unavailable.

title: Live candidate filtering matches training candidate filtering
current_evidence: Historical filters include spread mid size and ladder assumptions; live quote validation is not yet proven equivalent.
falsification_test: Build matched historical/live-style candidate parity harness for the same snapshots.
confidence_increases_if: Candidate inclusion exclusion and features match for sampled events.
confidence_destroyed_if: Live admits materially different candidates or missing causal fields.

title: Protocol066 lifecycle live input matches sequence-model training semantics
current_evidence: Lifecycle inference expects sequence context; live bridge may build a current-row surface.
falsification_test: Replay known paths through the live row builder and compare lifecycle actions step by step.
confidence_increases_if: Live lifecycle features and actions match replay for known trajectories.
confidence_destroyed_if: Live lifecycle diverges on hold exit stop or forced-flat decisions under identical paths.

title: Protocol051 surface edge represents opportunity quality rather than quote mechanics
current_evidence: Protocol101 depends on upstream surface scores and narrow filters.
falsification_test: Run matched controls by spread premium moneyness side time quote age liquidity and fillability.
confidence_increases_if: Edge remains after conditioning on liquidity and quote mechanics.
confidence_destroyed_if: Score advantage vanishes under matched liquidity/fillability controls.

title: Protocol101 margin ranks expected realized utility
current_evidence: Strategy forensics reported weak selected-trade score calibration.
falsification_test: Measure same-event candidate utility calibration including rejected candidates and execution costs.
confidence_increases_if: Higher margins monotonically improve realized utility after costs and fills.
confidence_destroyed_if: Margins are flat negative or regime-unstable after realistic costs.

title: Repeated exposed validation splits still predict future behavior
current_evidence: Known splits have been repeatedly examined in research iterations.
falsification_test: Freeze a candidate and score one future untouched block once after execution and parity gates pass.
confidence_increases_if: Untouched block behavior matches confidence intervals from prior gates.
confidence_destroyed_if: Performance collapses or changes sign on untouched block.

title: Ten thousand dollar account and reserve semantics match replay
current_evidence: Docs mention reserve semantics that may not be enforced identically in guard logic.
falsification_test: Run guard-identical account replay with explicit reserve subtraction rules.
confidence_increases_if: Replay and guard affordability decisions match exactly.
confidence_destroyed_if: Trades accepted by replay would be rejected by guard or account state.

title: IBKR paper fills approximate live execution
current_evidence: Paper-submit evidence is insufficient and live-money trading is not authorized.
falsification_test: Compare paper fill/cancel data to approved live micro-observations only if later authorized.
confidence_increases_if: Paper/live fill gaps are bounded and modeled conservatively.
confidence_destroyed_if: Paper fills are systematically optimistic versus live.

title: Fees and commissions are negligible for current trade distribution
current_evidence: Main labels and reports often treat costs lightly or separately.
falsification_test: Run fee sensitivity by side premium time archetype and turnover.
confidence_increases_if: Net edge survives conservative fee and commission schedules.
confidence_destroyed_if: Net expectancy disappears after realistic fees.
